name: mcp-manager
description: Local MCP hub for macOS: run every MCP server once, manage them from a web UI, and share them with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and remote machines over SSH.
author: vietqtran

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:app
scripts.build:engine:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
